data.description:
## Context / Problem
`docs/llm-framework.md` "Extras taxonomy" (`:43-68`) lists two extras and never mentions `evals`; no document tells a client project how to run plan-replay, fixture-mining, or provider-parity against its own `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` and `.rebar/evals/`. 71 open, parentless `fixture-drift:` tasks (for example `00b4-b253-3052-4181`) were filed by hand for story 67aa's acceptance criterion from `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/fixtures/drift-report.md`, each `discovered_from` the closed epic `65dd-e93b-666a-4caa`; `git grep fixture-drift` on origin/main is empty, and `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_mining/heal.py`'s only ticket producer is `_file_unreliable_ticket` (`heal.py:83` `UNRELIABLE_TITLE_PREFIX = "unreliable-criterion: "`, `:359-364`), while drift goes to `.rebar/fixture_heal_drift.md` (`:462`). Those 71 tasks have no producer and no consumer. Cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Add a `docs/llm-framework.md` section titled "Running the eval harnesses against your own criteria" after "Usage log" (`:509-593`), stating: install with `pip install 'nava-rebar[agents,evals]'`; criteria live in `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` and project prompts in `.rebar/prompts/<id>.md` (override order `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_selection.py:71-99`); specs in `.rebar/evals/<prompt_id>.eval.yaml` win over packaged ones (`src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py:58-75`); set `[llm.evals] corpus_root` (default `.rebar/evals`); then the exact commands: `rebar prompt eval <prompt_id>`; `rebar criteria eval [<criterion_id>] --changed-since origin/main --require-live`; `rebar criteria heal --dry-run` then `rebar criteria heal` (cap `$25`, `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_eval_commands.py:136`; outputs `.rebar/fixture_heal_drift.md`, `.rebar/fixture_heal_ledger.jsonl`, emitted `.rebar/evals/*.eval.yaml`; files `unreliable-criterion: <id>` tickets); `python -m rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay tier0 --candidate current`, `tier1 --n 20`, `tier2 --criteria E1` (writes under `<corpus_root>/plan-review-gate/replay/`, `--store name=path` for another store, `--ledger` to relocate spend); `python -m rebar.llm.evals.provider_parity --slot standard --epochs 3` (writes `<corpus_root>/provider-parity/provider_parity_results.json`); `REBAR_LLM_EVALS_CORPUS_ROOT=/scratch/evals` for CI. Add an `[evals]` bullet to the taxonomy and the `llm.evals.corpus_root` row to "Configuration" (`:408`). Add a `docs/llm-example-configs.md` snippet with `[llm.evals]` and `corpus_root = ".rebar/evals"`. Disposition of the 71 tasks, through the MCP server: for each id returned by `search("title:fixture-drift: status:open")`, `transition_ticket(id, "open", "closed", close_class="obsolete", reason="superseded by the scheduled fixture-heal loop (rebar criteria heal, heal.py), which re-mines every criterion on fixture_heal.interval_days, records drift in .rebar/fixture_heal_drift.md, and files one unreliable-criterion: ticket per criterion that fails three consecutive re-mines; per-entry drift tickets have no producer and no consumer")`; `obsolete` is reason-required administrative vocabulary that mints a disposition verdict without an LLM run (`docs/ticket-model.md:125-145`, `src/rebar/_commands/gates.py:143-148`); then `comment_ticket("65dd-e93b-666a-4caa", ...)` recording the batch. Release note (non-breaking, contract section): eval harness roots are configured (`llm.evals.corpus_root`, default `.rebar/evals`); `rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay.ledger.DEFAULT_LEDGER_PATH` removed (ledger defaults resolve at call time); `provider_parity --out` defaults under the corpus root; the `evals` extra is registered.

## Scope
`docs/llm-framework.md`; `docs/llm-example-configs.md`; `docs/release-notes.md`; `tests/unit/test_llm_framework_docs.py` (new: asserts the section heading and each command string); tracker writes on the 71 tickets plus one comment. No source files.

## Testing
Happy: `pytest tests/unit/test_llm_framework_docs.py -q`; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py`; every command in the section executed once in a temp client repo (`rebar init`, copy `.rebar/criteria_routing.json`) with `--dry-run` where offered; `rebar search "fixture-drift:" -o json | jq '[.[]|select(.status=="open")]|length'` prints `0`. Edge: `rebar prompt eval nonexistent-id` reports the missing spec path (`.rebar/evals/nonexistent-id.eval.yaml`) rather than a traceback; re-running the disposition batch is a no-op (each ticket is already closed, so the optimistic-concurrency refusal, exit 10, is expected and skipped).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The section is present with the seven command lines verbatim (doc test passes).
- [ ] `[evals]` appears in the extras taxonomy and `llm.evals.corpus_root` is documented with its default and env name.
- [ ] 0 open `fixture-drift:` tickets remain; each closed record carries `close_class: obsolete` and the reason (`rebar show <id> -o json`).
- [ ] The release-notes entry is present.
data.title: Document running the eval harnesses against a client's own criteria; register the evals extra; close the 71 orphaned fixture-drift tasks
